scope: support-foundation 0.6.0 adoption (devin/support-foundation-06): devDependency pin 2d034b3 → 8bb514d (v0.6.0), matching reviewed-input digests and the rebuilt dist/support-runtime.js bundle hash in scripts/support-runtime-policy.ts, the notice bump in docs/support-foundation-notice.md, X-7 help wiring — `supportAdvancedHelp()` block under the textbutler `help advanced` topic and the one-line `supportHelpLine()` root line in packages/textbutler/src/cli-help.ts — and the standalone messagelikeme HELP collapse in src/command-input.ts (agent verbs out of top-level help). package.json and bun.lock are receipt-covered; the rest ride along as reviewed collateral.

rounds.design: Bump the pin, refresh the policy digests, and call the new helpers everywhere the support line or verbs appear.
blockers: Importing @hraness/support-foundation/node directly in src/command-input.ts would break the standalone artifact: scripts/build-dist.ts keeps package imports external and admits the support library only through the reviewed dist/support-runtime.js bundle (isReviewedSupportRuntime), while the checked-support-runtime plugin throws on any importer of ./support-runtime.js other than src/support.ts. dist/cli.js would carry an unresolvable external specifier — the dep is a devDependency, never shipped. Fixed: src/command-input.ts keeps a literal line byte-identical to supportHelpLine({command:["messagelikeme"]}) output; only packages/textbutler (fully bundled by build-textbutler.ts, which rejects external imports) calls the helpers directly.

supportHelpLine/supportAdvancedHelp apply env-dependent ASCII substitution (HRANESS_ASCII/TERM=dumb/missing UTF-8 locale). Help bodies are module-level consts evaluated once at import, so ambient env would flip · to - nondeterministically against the golden snapshots. Fixed: both callsites pass env: { LANG: "en_US.UTF-8" }, pinning the UTF-8 form that every other static help line already uses.

0.6.0 silently changes support-surface behavior: `support --help` now exits 0 with human copy, and dismiss/snooze/enable/status take a bare human form while --json and detected agents keep JSON. Verified: textbutler cli.ts intercepts `support --help`/`-h` to its own topic before runSupportCommand, protocol --json output is byte-stable (hraness-support-protocol-v1, same command array), and src/support.test.ts passes unchanged.

The bundled dist/node.js now inlines detectAudience from desktop-foundation 0.8 — confirmed self-contained (only node: imports; no external specifier) so the reviewed-inputs digests remain a complete integrity statement.
